fields.label: Information
fields.name: information
fields.instructions: Short general information note about this vehicle. Displayed as a summary on the listing page.
fields.placeholder: Enter a brief vehicle information note...

fields.label: Message
fields.name: message
fields.instructions: Optional promotional or dealer message displayed prominently on the vehicle detail page (VDP).

fields.label: Sold
fields.name: sold
fields.instructions: Mark this vehicle as sold. Enter 'yes' or '1' to flag the listing as sold.

fields.label: Vehicle Status
fields.name: vehicle-status
fields.instructions: Current availability status of the vehicle (e.g. Available, In Transit, On Order).

fields.label: Mileage
fields.name: mileage
fields.instructions: Odometer reading in miles. Used for sorting and display on the listing.

fields.label: Miles Display
fields.name: miles_display
fields.instructions: Formatted mileage label shown to visitors (e.g. '25,000 miles'). Overrides the raw mileage value for display purposes.

fields.label: Comment 1
fields.name: comment1
fields.instructions: Supplemental comment line 1. Used for additional notes or marketing callouts from the feed.

fields.label: Comment 2
fields.name: comment2
fields.instructions: Supplemental comment line 2.

fields.label: Comment 3
fields.name: comment3
fields.instructions: Supplemental comment line 3.

fields.label: Comment 4
fields.name: comment4
fields.instructions: Supplemental comment line 4.

fields.label: Comment 5
fields.name: comment5
fields.instructions: Supplemental comment line 5.

fields.label: Status Code
fields.name: status_code
fields.instructions: Internal inventory status code from the dealer management system (DMS) feed.

fields.label: Date In Stock
fields.name: dateinstock
fields.instructions: The date this vehicle was added to inventory. Populated from the dealer feed (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.label: Exterior Color
fields.name: exterior_color
fields.instructions: Full exterior color name as provided by the manufacturer or dealer feed (e.g. 'Midnight Black Metallic').

fields.label: Interior Type
fields.name: interiortype
fields.instructions: Interior upholstery or material type (e.g. Leather, Cloth, Leatherette).

fields.label: Interior Color
fields.name: interior_color
fields.instructions: Full interior color name as provided by the manufacturer or dealer feed (e.g. 'Beige').

fields.label: Transmission Type
fields.name: transmission
fields.instructions: Transmission type (e.g. Automatic, Manual, CVT). Displayed on the vehicle detail page.

fields.label: Body Style
fields.name: bodystyle
fields.instructions: Vehicle body style from the dealer feed (e.g. SUV, Sedan, Truck). May differ from the Style field.

fields.label: Style
fields.name: body_style
fields.instructions: Vehicle body style used for filtering and display on the SRP (e.g. SUV, Sedan, Coupe, Truck).

fields.label: Trim
fields.name: trim
fields.instructions: Trim level or package name (e.g. EX-L, Sport, Platinum). Displayed on the listing title.

fields.label: Model
fields.name: model
fields.instructions: Vehicle model name (e.g. Camry, F-150, CR-V). Used in the listing title and filters.

fields.label: Make
fields.name: make
fields.instructions: Vehicle manufacturer brand (e.g. Toyota, Ford, Honda). Used in the listing title and filters.

fields.label: Year
fields.name: year
fields.instructions: Model year of the vehicle (4-digit format). Used in the listing title and filters.

fields.label: Vehicle Type
fields.name: condition
fields.instructions: Condition or type of vehicle (e.g. New, Used, Certified Pre-Owned). Used for filtering on the SRP.

fields.label: Stock Number
fields.name: stock_number
fields.instructions: Dealer stock number for this vehicle. Displayed on the VDP and used for inventory tracking.

fields.label: VIN
fields.name: vin_number
fields.instructions: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number. Must be unique per listing.

fields.label: URL
fields.name: url
fields.instructions: External or canonical URL for this vehicle listing, if sourced from a third-party feed.

fields.label: VDP Description
fields.name: vdp_description
fields.instructions: Each row is a separate description paragraph or bullet point displayed on the vehicle detail page (VDP). Add rows to build multi-part descriptions.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: One paragraph or bullet point of VDP description text.

fields.label: MPG Highway
fields.name: highway_mpg
fields.instructions: EPA-estimated highway fuel economy in miles per gallon (MPG). Populated from the vehicle feed.

fields.label: MPG City
fields.name: city_mpg
fields.instructions: EPA-estimated city fuel economy in miles per gallon (MPG). Populated from the vehicle feed.

fields.label: EPA Classification
fields.name: epaclassification
fields.instructions: EPA vehicle size/class classification (e.g. Compact Car, Midsize SUV). Sourced from the vehicle feed.

fields.label: Fuel Type
fields.name: fuel_type
fields.instructions: Type of fuel the vehicle uses (e.g. Gasoline, Diesel, Electric, Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid).

fields.label: Wheelbase Code
fields.name: wheelbase_code
fields.instructions: Manufacturer wheelbase code identifying the vehicle's wheelbase configuration from the feed.

fields.label: Engine Displacement
fields.name: enginedisplacement
fields.instructions: Engine displacement value (e.g. 2.5L, 3.5L). Sourced from the vehicle feed.

fields.label: Transmission Speed
fields.name: transmission_speed
fields.instructions: Number of transmission speeds or ratios (e.g. 6, 8, CVT).

fields.label: Transmission Description
fields.name: transmission_description
fields.instructions: Full transmission description as provided by the feed (e.g. '8-Speed Automatic with Sport Mode').

fields.label: Engine Block
fields.name: engineblock
fields.instructions: Engine block configuration code (e.g. V for V-type, I for inline). Sourced from the vehicle feed.

fields.label: Engine Cylinders
fields.name: enginecylinders
fields.instructions: Number of engine cylinders (e.g. 4, 6, 8). Sourced from the vehicle feed.

fields.label: Engine Size
fields.name: engine
fields.instructions: Human-readable engine size description displayed on the VDP (e.g. '3.5L V6').

fields.label: Engine Size Unit of Measure
fields.name: enginesizeuom
fields.instructions: Unit of measure for the engine size value (e.g. L for litres, cc for cubic centimetres).

fields.label: Drivetrain
fields.name: drivetrain
fields.instructions: Drivetrain configuration (e.g. FWD, AWD, RWD, 4WD). Used in filters and displayed on the VDP.

fields.label: Lease Payment
fields.name: lease_payment
fields.instructions: Monthly lease payment amount in dollars. Leave blank if no lease offer applies.

fields.label: Loan Payment
fields.name: loan_payment
fields.instructions: Monthly loan/finance payment amount in dollars. Leave blank if no finance offer applies.

fields.label: Loan Payment (Sort)
fields.name: loan_payment_sort
fields.instructions: Numeric loan payment value used for sort ordering on the SRP. Set to 0 to exclude from sorted results.

fields.label: Loan Payment (Sort 1)
fields.name: loan_payment_sort_1
fields.instructions: Secondary numeric loan payment value used for an alternate sort order on the SRP.

fields.label: Due at Signing
fields.name: down_payment
fields.instructions: Amount due at lease signing, including down payment, fees, and first month (e.g. '$2,999 due at signing').

fields.label: Lease Term
fields.name: leaseterm
fields.instructions: Duration of the lease in months (e.g. 36, 48).

fields.label: Loan Term
fields.name: loanterm
fields.instructions: Duration of the loan in months (e.g. 60, 72).

fields.label: Loan APR
fields.name: loanapr
fields.instructions: Annual Percentage Rate (APR) for the finance offer, as a percentage (e.g. 3.9).

fields.label: Total of Payments
fields.name: totalofpmts
fields.instructions: Total amount paid over the full loan or lease term (sum of all monthly payments).

fields.label: Price
fields.name: price
fields.instructions: Selling price of the vehicle displayed to shoppers. Used for sorting and filtering on the SRP.

fields.label: Price (Sort)
fields.name: price_sort
fields.instructions: Numeric price value used for sort ordering on the SRP. Typically mirrors Price but can be adjusted.

fields.label: MSRP
fields.name: original_price
fields.instructions: Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price. Displayed alongside the selling price to show savings.

fields.label: Invoice Amount
fields.name: invoiceamount
fields.instructions: Dealer invoice price (what the dealer paid). Internal use only — not typically shown to shoppers.

fields.label: Default Book Value
fields.name: defaultbookvalue
fields.instructions: Standard book value of the vehicle (e.g. from Black Book or KBB). Used for internal pricing reference.

fields.label: Internet Price
fields.name: internetprice
fields.instructions: Special price offered exclusively online. Leave blank if the internet price equals the standard price.

fields.label: Custom Price 1
fields.name: customprice1
fields.instructions: Custom pricing field 1 from the dealer feed. Usage depends on dealer configuration.

fields.label: Custom Price 2
fields.name: customprice2
fields.instructions: Custom pricing field 2 from the dealer feed. Usage depends on dealer configuration.

fields.label: Custom Price 3
fields.name: customprice3
fields.instructions: Custom pricing field 3 from the dealer feed. Usage depends on dealer configuration.

fields.label: Pack
fields.name: pack
fields.instructions: Dealer pack amount — a fixed cost added to the vehicle's cost basis for profitability calculations. Internal use only.

fields.label: Holdback
fields.name: holdback
fields.instructions: Manufacturer holdback amount paid back to the dealer after sale. Internal use only.

fields.label: Cost
fields.name: cost
fields.instructions: Dealer's total cost basis for this vehicle. Internal use only — not shown to shoppers.

fields.label: Primary Image URL
fields.name: primaryimageurl
fields.instructions: URL of the primary vehicle image used as the main photo on the SRP card and VDP. Recommended size: 800x600px or larger.

fields.label: Primary Thumbnail URL
fields.name: primarythumburl
fields.instructions: URL of the primary vehicle thumbnail image used in smaller display contexts. Recommended size: 400x300px.

fields.label: Use Images List
fields.name: use_images_list
fields.instructions: Choose which image gallery is displayed on the VDP and SRP. 'Primary' uses the main gallery; 'Alternative' uses the SRP gallery.

fields.label: Image URL List — Primary
fields.name: gallery
fields.instructions: Primary vehicle photo gallery. Each row is one image URL. Images appear in the VDP slideshow in the order listed. Recommended image size: 800x600px minimum.

sub_fields.label: Image URL
sub_fields.name: image_url
sub_fields.instructions: Full URL to the vehicle photo. Must be a publicly accessible image URL.

sub_fields.label: Image Background Removed
sub_fields.name: image_background
sub_fields.instructions: Enable if this image has had its background removed (transparent or white background). Affects how the image is rendered in the gallery.

sub_fields.label: Image Reversed
sub_fields.name: image_reverse
sub_fields.instructions: Enable if this image should be horizontally flipped (mirrored) for display purposes.

fields.label: Image URL List — Alternative
fields.name: gallery_srp
fields.instructions: Alternative vehicle photo gallery (e.g. for SRP cards or a secondary photo set). Each row is one image URL. Recommended image size: 800x600px minimum.

sub_fields.label: Image URL
sub_fields.name: image_url
sub_fields.instructions: Full URL to the vehicle photo. Must be a publicly accessible image URL.

sub_fields.label: Image Background Removed
sub_fields.name: image_background
sub_fields.instructions: Enable if this image has had its background removed (transparent or white background). Affects how the image is rendered in the gallery.

sub_fields.label: Image Reversed
sub_fields.name: image_reverse
sub_fields.instructions: Enable if this image should be horizontally flipped (mirrored) for display purposes.

fields.label: Vehicle Overview
fields.name: vehicle_overview
fields.instructions: Full editorial description of the vehicle displayed on the VDP. Can include highlights, history, and selling points.

fields.label: Photo Timestamp
fields.name: photo_timestamp
fields.instructions: Timestamp of when the vehicle photos were taken or last updated. Populated from the feed (format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

fields.label: Passenger Capacity
fields.name: passengercapacity
fields.instructions: Total number of passengers the vehicle can seat (e.g. 5, 7, 8).

fields.label: Market Class
fields.name: marketclass
fields.instructions: Market segment or class for this vehicle (e.g. Compact SUV, Full-Size Pickup). Sourced from the vehicle feed.

fields.label: Factory Codes
fields.name: factory_codes
fields.instructions: Manufacturer factory option codes associated with this vehicle. Sourced from the dealer or manufacturer feed.

fields.label: Certified
fields.name: certified
fields.instructions: Certified Pre-Owned status. Enter 'yes' or '1' if this vehicle is CPO certified. Displays a CPO badge on the listing.

fields.label: Certified Custom URL
fields.name: certified_custom_url
fields.instructions: Optional custom URL for the CPO program page. Overrides the default certified link on the VDP badge.

fields.label: Interior Color Code
fields.name: int_color_code
fields.instructions: Manufacturer interior color code. Used for filtering and color swatch display.

fields.label: Exterior Color Code
fields.name: ext_color_code
fields.instructions: Manufacturer exterior color code. Used for filtering and color swatch display.

fields.label: Model Number
fields.name: modelnumber
fields.instructions: Manufacturer model number or model code (e.g. YF1BF2JN). Sourced from the vehicle feed.

fields.label: Doors
fields.name: doors
fields.instructions: Number of doors on the vehicle (e.g. 2, 4). Sourced from the vehicle feed.

fields.label: Features
fields.name: features
fields.instructions: Each row is a single vehicle feature or highlight (e.g. 'Heated Seats', 'Sunroof', 'Apple CarPlay'). These are displayed as a feature list on the VDP.

sub_fields.label: Feature
sub_fields.name: feature
sub_fields.instructions: A single vehicle feature or highlight.

fields.label: Exterior Color Hex Code
fields.name: extcolorhexcode
fields.instructions: Hex color code for the vehicle's exterior color, used to render color swatches (e.g. #1A1A1A). Include the leading #.

fields.label: Interior Color Hex Code
fields.name: intcolorhexcode
fields.instructions: Hex color code for the vehicle's interior color, used to render color swatches (e.g. #C8A882). Include the leading #.

fields.label: Exterior Color Generic
fields.name: ext_color_generic
fields.instructions: Generic exterior color family name used for color filtering (e.g. Black, White, Silver, Red). Should match the filter option values.

fields.label: Interior Color Generic
fields.name: int_color_generic
fields.instructions: Generic interior color family name used for color filtering (e.g. Black, Beige, Gray). Should match the filter option values.

fields.label: Options
fields.name: features_options
fields.instructions: Each row is a factory-installed or dealer-installed option/package on this vehicle. Populated from the dealer feed. Displayed in the Equipment section on the VDP.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Name or description of a single equipment option or package (e.g. 'Premium Sound System', 'Tow Package').

fields.label: Dealer ID
fields.name: location
fields.instructions: Unique dealer identifier from the inventory feed. Used to associate this listing with a specific dealership location.

fields.label: Dealer Name
fields.name: dealer_name
fields.instructions: Full legal or trade name of the dealership (e.g. 'Acme Toyota'). Sourced from the feed.

fields.label: Dealer Address
fields.name: dealer_address
fields.instructions: Street address of the dealership (e.g. '123 Main St').

fields.label: Dealer City
fields.name: dealer_city
fields.instructions: City where the dealership is located.

fields.label: Dealer State
fields.name: dealer_state
fields.instructions: State abbreviation where the dealership is located (e.g. CA, TX, NY).

fields.label: Dealer Zip
fields.name: dealer_zip
fields.instructions: ZIP or postal code of the dealership.

fields.label: Dealer Phone
fields.name: dealer_phone
fields.instructions: Primary phone number for the dealership. Displayed on the VDP contact section.

fields.label: Dealer Contact
fields.name: dealer_contact
fields.instructions: Name of the primary dealer contact or sales representative.

fields.label: Dealer Email
fields.name: dealer_email
fields.instructions: Dealer contact email address for lead routing and VDP inquiry forms.

fields.label: Dealer Fax
fields.name: dealer_fax
fields.instructions: Dealer fax number. Sourced from the feed; rarely displayed publicly.

fields.label: Dealer Special
fields.name: dealer_special
fields.instructions: Dealer-specific special offer or promotional note associated with this listing.
